research_object: total effect of assigning a diagnostic-delegation policy at a frozen real unfinished state

common_preparation.content: Only public issue, existing repository baseline, a minimal unfinished diagnostic objective and initial owner 001; no answer or reference patch locations

candidate_prefix_limits.checkpoint_trigger: Stop at first eight settled opportunities (earlier if 300k already used); review current evidence, do not force continuation if diagnosis complete
candidate_prefix_limits.incomplete_panel_policy: report shortage; no toy substitution or unregistered extra candidates
candidate_prefix_limits.completed_diagnosis_policy: admission negative control; no forced reassignment continuation

assignment.KEEP: Retain existing diagnostic responsibility; no extra resume message or dummy management work
assignment.REASSIGN: One frozen instruction to attempt original offer/accept and necessary information handoff; model chooses actual actions and diagnosis
assignment.execution_order: seeded paired interleaving, freeze before outcomes; first two opposite-arm slots are inside the main denominator

resources.branch_tokens: same checkpoint remainder, not a new 5M grant
resources.pause_time: Exclude checkpoint IO and process downtime equally; report their preparation cost separately
resources.branch_time: same saved soft/hard remainder; charge all intervention work within it
resources.whole_experiment_cost: all attempted prefixes plus all continuations plus environment and scoring

analysis.primary: ITT: legal submitted version passes official scoring
analysis.separate_code_endpoint: locked final worktree official correctness; never substitute for a different submitted version
analysis.technical_unknown: report unknown and bounds; do not fill as ordinary failure
analysis.experimental_unit: decision state; two repeats are not two independent tasks

provider_stage_gate: Request identity, restoration, tool/feedback and billing integrity for first two registered real slots; never gate on official scores
